foreign_ownership_limit.zh: 无明确外资持股/准入上限。Eurex 的准入对象是「获准公司」（Admitted Companies）与「交易员」（Exchange Traders）；交易所规则明确允许注册地在外国的获准公司参与交易（见 exchange_rules 原文「registered office abroad」「located outside the Federal Republic of Germany」），欧盟/欧洲经济区机构凭护照制度准入，第三国机构亦可作为获准公司被接纳。未检索到对外资持股比例的封顶条款。
foreign_ownership_limit.en: No explicit foreign-ownership / participation cap. Eurex admits 'Admitted Companies' and 'Exchange Traders'; the rules expressly contemplate Admitted Companies with their registered office abroad and Participant Trading Systems located outside Germany, so foreign entities are admissible. EU/EEA firms access via passport, and third-country firms may also be admitted. No statutory cap on foreign shareholding was found.

capital_controls.zh: 无资本管制与外汇管制。Eurex 位于德国/欧盟单一市场，《欧盟运作条约》(TFEU) 第 63 条禁止一切资本与支付在成员国之间及成员国与第三国之间的流动限制；德国自 1990 年起已实现资本自由流动，近年仅塞浦路斯(2015)、希腊(2019)曾短暂实施资本管制，德国不在其列。
capital_controls.en: No capital or FX controls. Eurex sits within the German/EU single market; Article 63 TFEU prohibits all restrictions on the movement of capital and payments between Member States and between Member States and third countries. Germany has had fully liberalised capital movements since 1990; only Cyprus (2015) and Greece (2019) briefly imposed controls among EU states.

capital_controls.quote: all restrictions on the movement of capital between Member States and between Member States and third countries shall be prohibited. ／ The general principle about free movement of capital is defined in Art. 63 TFEU. ／ Capital movements were fully liberalised by the directive for the implementation of Article 67 of the Treaty in 1988, which scrapped all remaining restrictions on capital movements between Member State residents as of 1 July 1990. ／ Cyprus (2013) and Greece (2015) were forced to introduce capital controls in order to prevent an excessive outflow of capital. Cyprus removed all of the remaining restrictions in 2015 and Greece did so in 2019.

disclosure_requirements.zh: 衍生品交易所并无「上市公司信息披露」制度；与本所最接近的披露义务是持仓/头寸披露：交易监视办公室（Trading Surveillance Office）检视获准公司的全部持仓以核实是否符合持仓限额，并在最后交易日等时点要求报送客户头寸明细。
disclosure_requirements.en: A derivatives exchange has no 'corporate disclosure' regime; the closest obligation is position disclosure: the Trading Surveillance Office examines all positions of an Admitted Company to verify compliance with position limits and requires customer-position reporting at certain times (e.g. by 10 a.m. on the last Trading Day before expiry).

investor_protection.zh: 投资者保护主要通过中央对手方（CCP）机制实现：Eurex Clearing 作为 CCP 对每笔交易进行合约更替（novation），担保履约，并依 EMIR 对客户头寸实施隔离（segregation）与可移植性（portability）安排；违约时依违约处置瀑布优先用违约方资源，再动用共同违约基金。这是专业/机构市场的制度性保护，而非现货交易所式的散户赔偿基金。
investor_protection.en: Investor protection is primarily delivered through the central counterparty (CCP) mechanism: Eurex Clearing, authorised as a CCP under EMIR, novates every trade, guarantees performance, and applies client-position segregation and portability under EMIR; on a member default the default waterfall uses the defaulter's resources first, then the mutual Default Fund. This is institutional/professional-market protection, not a retail investor-compensation fund.

circuit_breaker.quote: If the conditions required for a Volatility Interruption are satisfied for a particular Instrument, the Management Board may, in addition to Sentence 1, interrupt continuous trading for all Instruments of the respective Derivative.

volatility_interruption.zh: 波动性中断（Volatility Interruption）：预期成交价超出动态或静态价格区间即触发，中断后以集合竞价方式恢复交易（紧接的收盘集合竞价除外）
volatility_interruption.en: Volatility Interruption: triggered when the next expected execution price falls outside the dynamic or static price range; trading resumes via an auction (unless immediately followed by a Closing Auction)
volatility_interruption.quote: Immediately after a Volatility Interruption, exchange trading shall be resumed in the respective Instrument or Derivative with an auction period unless a Closing Auction pursuant to Number 1.4 Paragraph 3 follows immediately thereafter.

trading_halt_mechanism.en: See volatility_interruption; halts due to technical failures or under Section 25 of the German Stock Exchange Act also exist but were not individually verified

spec.note: 「Mistrade」制度（Conditions for Trading 2.9）。只有成交时处于不利一方的会员可申请，须在成交后 30 分钟内（且在该衍生品当日交易时段结束后 30 分钟内）向管理董事会提交；逾期至 3 小时内另有更严条件。构成 Mistrade 的价格偏离区间（Mistrade Ranges）由管理董事会按每个衍生品逐一确定并公布，无统一百分比——市场波动加剧时可设 Fast-Market Period，期权 Mistrade Range 翻倍。期权净额成交中受益方可要求价格修正（Price Correction）以替代作废

error_trade_rule.zh: 「错误交易（Mistrade）」制度：仅成交时处于不利一方的会员可申请由管理董事会作废，须在成交后 30 分钟内（且在该衍生品当日交易时段结束后 30 分钟内）提交；逾 30 分钟至 3 小时内另有更严格条件。构成错误交易的价格偏离区间（Mistrade Ranges）由管理董事会按每个衍生品逐一确定并公布，无统一百分比表；市场波动加剧时管理董事会可设 Fast-Market Period，其间期权的 Mistrade Range 翻倍。期权净额成交中的受益方可要求价格修正以替代作废
error_trade_rule.en: Mistrade regime: only the member that was at a disadvantage in the transaction may apply; the application must be submitted to the Management Board within 30 minutes of conclusion (and within 30 minutes of the end of that Derivative's Trading Period that day), with stricter conditions for applications after 30 minutes up to 3 hours. The price-deviation intervals that constitute a mistrade (Mistrade Ranges) are set and published by the Management Board per Derivative — there is no single percentage; during a Fast-Market Period the option Mistrade Ranges double. For options transactions in the netting process the benefiting party may demand a Price Correction instead of cancellation
error_trade_rule.detail: Conditions for Trading at Eurex Deutschland 2.9.2–2.9.5。衍生品所——与 trading_halt_mechanism 不同。resolution 取 cancel_or_adjust：一般为作废，期权净额成交场景可改为价格修正。deviation_threshold_pct 留 null（Mistrade Ranges 逐产品公布，非统一值）。

error_trade_rule.quote: Only the business party which is at a disadvantage in this Transaction at the time of conclusion is entitled to submit an application (“Entitled Admitted Company”). ... The Management Board shall cancel a Transaction if such cancellation has been applied for ... within 30 minutes upon its conclusion and before expiration of 30 minutes after termination of the Trading Period of the respective Derivative ... The Management Board shall determine the intervals respectively applicable for deviations to the reference price ... outside which a Transaction pursuant to the regulations in Number 2.9 are cancelled or whose price may be corrected for the respective Derivative (“Mistrade Ranges”) and shall publish them. ... For the Transactions in options Contracts accomplished during a Fast-Market Period, the Mistrade Ranges applicable pursuant to Paragraph 1 reduplicate.

intraday_reversal.detail: 衍生品合约的开仓 / 平仓当日可自由进行，不存在现货市场「买入的证券在交收前不得卖出」这一持有期限制的概念——本字段的设计前提（T+0 / T+1 式回转限制）对纯衍生品交易所不成立。OPEN-QUESTIONS #17 已就 de-eurex 三个现货前提字段（settlement_cycle / short_selling / intraday_reversal）的不适配定调（[ADR-035] E / [ADR-059]），本次按 [ADR-060] 字段级 not_applicable 机制显式标记，移出完成度分母。

short_selling.detail: 衍生品的'卖出开仓'（如卖出期货、卖出看涨期权）在机制上不同于股票卖空（不涉及借券），该字段的设计前提本身是股票市场概念，对本所不完全适用，留空不强行套用，记入OPEN-QUESTIONS。

block_trade.zh: Eurex 通过 T7 Entry Service（TES）等场外机制支持大宗交易（Block Trades）——即超过特定订单量的期货／期权合约交易，合格品种与最低订单量由管理董事会按品种在合约规格中规定（如 DAX 期货最低 250 张；EURO STOXX 50 指数期权非披露式双边 TES 交易最低 25,000 张）。TES 属《交易条件》第 4 部分「场外交易」，另有 Eurex EnLight 选择性询价
block_trade.en: Eurex supports Block Trades via off-book mechanisms such as the T7 Entry Service (TES): transactions in futures and options contracts exceeding a specific order volume, with eligible contracts and the minimum order volume set per product by the Management Board in the Contract Specifications (e.g. a 250-contract minimum for DAX Futures; a 25,000-contract minimum for non-disclosed bilateral TES transactions in EURO STOXX 50 Index Options). TES sits in Part 4 'Off-book Trading' of the Conditions for Trading, alongside the Eurex EnLight selective RFQ service
block_trade.detail: Eurex 为纯衍生品交易所，本字段描述其衍生品大宗机制（无现货『大宗交易时段』概念）。DAX 期货 250 张、EURO STOXX 50 指数期权披露式 TES 1,000 张 / 非披露式 25,000 张，均取自各自产品页的 Block Trade Service 说明，属逐品种参数、会随管理董事会决定调整。

The eligible futures and options Contracts and the minimum Order volume for Block Trades are determined by the Management Board in the Contract Specifications. …… Block Trade Service with a Minimum Block Trade Size of 250 contracts …… Minimum Block Trade Size for non-disclosed bilateral TES transactions is 25,000 contracts

order_book_transparency.zh: 盘前：Eurex T7 为公开的中央电子订单簿，展示订单的价量向市场披露、按价格-时间优先撮合（市价单优先于限价单和报价），支持冰山订单（仅部分数量展示）。无独立暗池；大额交易走场外报告类型（Off-book / Eurex EnLight RFQ）并适用衍生品成交披露延迟。盘后：适用欧盟 MiFIR 衍生品成交透明度制度
order_book_transparency.en: Pre-trade: Eurex T7 is a public central electronic order book whose displayed order sizes and prices are disseminated and matched on price-time priority (Market Orders ahead of Limit Orders and Quotes), with Iceberg Orders showing only a portion. There is no separate dark pool; large trades use off-book reporting types (Off-book / Eurex EnLight RFQ) with the applicable deferrals for derivatives. Post-trade: the EU MiFIR post-trade transparency regime for derivatives applies
order_book_transparency.detail: 字段管本所订单簿内部的（非）展示流动性；行情层级 / 收费见第十章。quote 复用 matching_principle 已核实措辞（市价单优先）；冰山单见 order_types。盘后延迟为 MiFIR 一般制度、未逐字核实产品级参数，故整体 confidence: medium。

order_book_transparency.quote: Market Orders shall always be executed before Limit Orders or Quotes, as the case may be, are executed.

dark_pool.detail: 『暗池 / 场外交易』是股票市场结构概念——与明盘交易所并列、不提供盘前透明度的非展示撮合场所（ATS / MTF / ALP）。Eurex 为纯衍生品交易所，无现货订单簿、无与之竞争的股票暗池生态，本字段的设计前提不成立。Eurex 的场外／大宗议价成交走 T7 Entry Service（TES，见 block_trade），依 MiFIR 大额（LIS）盘前透明度豁免运作，属场外交易设施而非暗池。按 [ADR-060] 字段级 not_applicable 机制显式标记、移出完成度分母，与本所 intraday_reversal / board_lot_size / odd_lot_handling / price_limits.other_boards 的处理一致（见框架性问题 #17）。

market_maker_scheme.zh: 受监管做市商制度（Regulated Market Maker）：需申请获得资格，须在至少一个衍生品品种上按月平均覆盖每日交易时段50%的时间持续提供双边报价，具体点差/报价量要求由管理董事会另行规定
market_maker_scheme.en: Regulated Market Maker system: admission required; must continuously enter binding two-way quotes in at least one Derivative covering 50% of daily Trading Hours on a monthly average, with specific spread/volume requirements set separately by the Management Board
market_maker_scheme.detail: 该义务框架依据欧盟《受托规例》(EU) 2017/578（MiFID II项下做市商监管规则）确定。

sources.title: Exchange Rules（官网英文版PDF）§48-49

market_maker_scheme.quote: the Exchange Traders acting on behalf of the Regulated Market Maker are required to continuously enter binding Quotes in at least one Derivative and during 50% of the daily Trading Hours on a monthly average.

connect_schemes.zh: 无沪港通式的跨境股票互联互通机制（现货概念，对纯衍生品所本不适用）。Eurex 面向境外提供直接市场准入：美国参与者可依 SEC class no-action relief 与 2009 年 SEC 令 / 《商品交易法》直接接入合格期权与外国证券期货品种；准入由各法域监管安排规定，非交易所间订单路由连接
connect_schemes.en: No cross-border stock-connect scheme of the Stock Connect type (a cash-market concept that does not really apply to a pure derivatives exchange). Eurex offers direct market access from abroad: U.S. participants may access eligible options and foreign security-futures products under SEC class no-action relief and the 2009 SEC Order / Commodity Exchange Act; access is governed by per-jurisdiction regulatory arrangements rather than an inter-exchange order-routing link
connect_schemes.detail: 「无股票互联互通」对衍生品所是范畴不适配（见框架性问题 #17），此处如实说明并给出 Eurex 实际的跨境准入形态。

sources.title: Conditions for Trading at Eurex Deutschland（官网英文版PDF）

settlement_cycle.detail: 衍生品没有股票市场T+N式的'结算周期'概念——持仓每日盯市（mark-to-market）结算保证金，最终交割/现金结算发生在合约到期日，与'买入证券几天后收货'不是同一种时间结构，该字段的enum设计前提对衍生品交易所不完全适用，留空不强行套用，记入OPEN-QUESTIONS。

guarantee_model.zh: 独立法人 Eurex Clearing AG（欧洲期货结算公司）作为中央对手方，专属处理 Eurex 成交的清算——经更替（novation）成为每个买方的卖方、每个卖方的买方
guarantee_model.en: The separate legal entity Eurex Clearing AG acts as central counterparty, handling clearing for Eurex transactions exclusively — interposing by novation as buyer to every seller and seller to every buyer

guarantee_model.quote: the Clearing in respect of these Transactions shall be handled exclusively by Eurex Clearing AG in its capacity as a central counterparty.

initial_margin_practice.zh: Eurex Clearing Prisma：基于会员整体持仓组合计算保证金的方法（而非逐笔/逐品种），可反映对冲与品种间相关性带来的风险抵消效应，覆盖场内与场外产品
initial_margin_practice.en: Eurex Clearing Prisma: a portfolio-based margin methodology (rather than trade-by-trade or product-by-product) that accounts for hedging and cross-correlation effects, covering both ETD and OTC products

sources.title: Margining Process（Eurex官网）

initial_margin_practice.quote: Eurex Clearing Prisma, a robust portfolio-based risk management method has been introduced for all ETD and OTC products. The Eurex Clearing Prisma method is based on the view of each member's entire portfolio and has the advantage of accounting for hedging and cross-correlation effects through determining the margin requirement on a portfolio level as opposed to a product-by-product view.

maintenance_margin_practice.zh: Eurex 不另设与初始保证金分离的「维持保证金阈值」（不同于美股 Reg T 模式）；其做法是以 Eurex Clearing Prisma 计算的初始保证金要求为底线，按持仓价格变动实时（real-time）重算并随时追加保证金（intraday margin calls），叠加按日盯市的变动保证金（variation margin）。即「维持」通过实时重估初始保证金要求实现，而非单独一条维持线。
maintenance_margin_practice.en: Eurex does not use a separate 'maintenance margin' threshold distinct from initial margin (unlike the U.S. Reg T model); instead the Initial Margin requirement (Prisma) is the baseline, recalculated in real time as positions/prices change with intraday margin calls, plus daily variation-margin settlement. 'Maintenance' is achieved by continuously re-measuring the Initial Margin requirement.

sources.title: Margining Process（Eurex官网）

maintenance_margin_practice.quote: Eurex Clearing calculates real-time the margin requirements for derivatives products by any position or price change. Margin information for equity and fixed income cash products are provided every ten minutes.

mark_to_market_frequency.zh: 按日盯市（每日盈亏结算）通过变动保证金（variation margin）实现；同时保证金要求在交易时段内按持仓/价格变动实时重算，股票与固定收益现货产品的保证金信息每十分钟提供一次
mark_to_market_frequency.en: Daily mark-to-market via variation margin (daily settlement of profits and losses); in addition, margin requirements are recalculated in real time as positions/prices change during the trading session, with margin information for equity and fixed-income cash products provided every ten minutes

sources.title: Margining Process（Eurex官网）

mark_to_market_frequency.quote: Variation margin (i.e. daily settlement of profits and losses) as well as premiums on traditional options and futures on options must be paid in cash. ／ Eurex Clearing calculates real-time the margin requirements for derivatives products by any position or price change.

delivery_method.zh: 视产品而定：实物交割为默认方式（如部分利率/债券期货），管理董事会可决定排除实物交割改为现金结算
delivery_method.en: Depends on the product: physical delivery is the default for some products (e.g. certain interest-rate/bond futures); the Management Board may rule out physical delivery in favor of cash settlement
delivery_method.detail: 这是与四家现货标杆（均填na）最实质性的字段差异——衍生品交易所是本项目第一次真正用上delivery_method这个字段。

sources.title: Exchange Rules（官网英文版PDF）§ 相关条款（物理交割排除与现金结算条款）

delivery_method.quote: In case of an exclusion of physical delivery pursuant to Clause 1 (iii) or Clause 2 (ii), a cash settlement of the relevant Contracts shall take place.

last_trading_day_rule.zh: 最后交易日与到期/最终结算日按各合约的产品说明书（Contract Specifications）逐一规定，由管理董事会确定，无全市场统一规则。以最具代表性的 EURO STOXX 50® 指数期权为例：最后交易日即为最终结算日，最终结算日为每个到期月的第三个周五（若为交易日；否则为该日之前最近的交易日）。期货的最后交易日则通常为交割/结算日前一营业日。
last_trading_day_rule.en: The last trading day and expiry/final settlement are defined per contract in the Contract Specifications and set by the Management Board; there is no single exchange-wide rule. For the flagship EURO STOXX 50® Index Options, the last trading day is the final settlement day, which is the third Friday of each expiration month (or the preceding exchange day if that is not an exchange day). For futures the last trading day is typically a business day before delivery/settlement.

sources.title: EURO STOXX 50® Index Options（产品说明书页）

last_trading_day_rule.quote: Last trading day is the final settlement day. Final settlement day is the third Friday of each expiration month if this is an exchange day; otherwise the exchange day immediately preceding that day. ／ EURO STOXX 50® Index Options

spec.note: 单一、跨所有资产类别的联合违约基金；顺序为 Eurex Clearing Default Management Process 明列

default_management.zh: 违约处置采用多层「违约瀑布」（Default Waterfall / Lines of Defense）：先动用违约结算会员自身的保证金抵押与违约基金出资；不足时依次动用 Eurex Clearing 的自有「Skin in the Game」出资、非违约会员的违约基金出资（含「Second Skin in the Game」）及 Eurex Clearing 剩余资本。设有单一、跨所有资产类别的联合违约基金。
default_management.en: Default management uses a multi-level 'Default Waterfall' (Lines of Defense): first the defaulter's own margin collateral and Default Fund contribution are used; if insufficient, Eurex Clearing's own 'Skin in the Game', then non-defaulting members' Default Fund contributions (including 'Second Skin in the Game') and Eurex Clearing's remaining capital follow. There is one joint Default Fund covering all asset classes.

sources.title: Default Management Process（Eurex Clearing 官网 PDF）

default_management.quote: Eurex Clearing provides a multi-level security system ／ First the collateral and the Default Fund contribution of the member in default are utilized. ／ After the defaulter’s contributions are exhausted, an assigned dedicated amount of Eurex Clearing, a so-called 'Skin in the Game', is applied, before non-defaulting clearing members’ Default Fund contributions, a 'Second Skin in the Game' and remaining capital of Eurex Clearing are used.

investor_structure.zh: 以机构与专业客户为主：参与方包括银行、资产管理公司、对冲基金、自营交易商及通过其开户的终端客户；Eurex 是面向专业/批发市场的衍生品交易所，散户经会员（经纪商）间接参与。本所未逐产品公布投资者结构明细，本次未核实具体占比。
investor_structure.en: Institution- and professional-client dominated: participants are banks, asset managers, hedge funds, proprietary trading firms and their clients; Eurex is a professional/wholesale derivatives market, with retail accessing indirectly via member brokers. Per-product investor-structure breakdowns are not published and were not individually verified this session.
investor_structure.detail: 这是专业衍生品市场的结构性特征，非某条具体规则的引文；confidence 标 medium。

account_opening_requirements.zh: 终端客户不直接向 Eurex 开户，而是向获准公司（会员/经纪商）开立交易与清算账户；要成为可参与 Eurex 交易的机构，须先成为「获准公司」（Admitted Company）并安排通过「交易员资格考试」（Exchange Trader Examination）的交易员代表其下单。
account_opening_requirements.en: End clients do not open accounts directly with Eurex but with Admitted Companies (member brokers); to trade, a firm must first become an 'Admitted Company' and have Exchange Traders who passed the Exchange Trader Examination placing orders on its behalf.

suitability_management.zh: 交易所层面的适当性门槛体现在「交易员资格考试」（Exchange Trader Examination）对代表获准公司下单人员的资质要求；面向终端客户的投资者适当性由会员依 MiFID II 自行履行，Eurex 规则本身不直接规定零售客户适当性。
suitability_management.en: At exchange level, the suitability gate is the Exchange Trader Examination requiring qualified personnel to trade on behalf of Admitted Companies; client-facing suitability is performed by members under MiFID II, and Eurex's own rules do not prescribe retail-client suitability.

fx_risk_note.zh: 欧元汇率在全球外汇市场上随行就市、不断变动，且欧洲央行明确汇率不是其政策目标，不试图通过货币政策操作影响汇率（ECB 官方 explainer，见 sources）。对非欧元投资者：欧元计价合约承担欧元兑投资者本币的汇率风险；本所产品覆盖多币种计价，风险随具体产品计价货币而定（见 overview.trading_currency）；区内资金自由流动属单一市场制度安排，见 capital_controls
fx_risk_note.en: The euro exchange rate changes constantly on global foreign exchange markets, and the ECB states explicitly that the exchange rate is not a policy target — it does not try to influence the exchange rate with its monetary policy operations (official ECB explainer, see sources). For non-euro investors: euro-denominated contracts carry EUR exchange-rate risk against the investor's currency; products here are denominated in multiple currencies, so risk follows each product's denomination currency (see overview.trading_currency); free movement of capital within the Single Market is covered in capital_controls
fx_risk_note.quote: The exchange rate is not a policy target of the ECB. This means that the ECB does not try to influence the exchange rate with its monetary policy operations.

political_risk_note.zh: 德国/欧盟政治与法律环境总体稳定；主要地缘与政策风险来自欧盟/美国监管分化（如 EMIR 3.0 对第三国 CCP 的敞口限制、潜在欧盟金融业交易税）、制裁机制（如对俄制裁影响特定合约）以及欧元区能源/地缘冲击。Eurex Clearing 作为受 BaFin/ESMA 监管的 CCP，其稳健性亦受欧盟监管政策演变影响。
political_risk_note.en: The German/EU political and legal environment is broadly stable; principal geopolitical and policy risks stem from EU/US regulatory divergence (e.g. EMIR 3.0 limits on third-country CCP exposure, potential EU FTT), sanction regimes (e.g. Russia-related affecting specific contracts), and Eurozone energy/geopolitical shocks. Eurex Clearing, as a BaFin/ESMA-supervised CCP, is also exposed to evolving EU regulatory policy.

liquidity_risk_note.zh: 流动性风险集中于产品：旗舰指数/利率衍生品（EURO STOXX 50、DAX、Bund 等）为深度最佳的长尾市场板块，但长尾与部分商品/单一股票合约流动性较浅，极端行情下冲击成本上升。流动性供给的制度锚是 Eurex 交易规则（Börsenordnung）第九章的受监管做市商制度：受监管做市商的交易所交易员须在月均意义上于至少一份衍生品上、在每日交易时段的 50% 时间内持续输入约束性报价，且须满足管理董事会设定的最大价差与报价量要求（逐字原文见 quote，Börsenordnung § 49）；定价与分层含义属分析性归纳
liquidity_risk_note.en: Liquidity risk is product-concentrated: flagship index/rate contracts (EURO STOXX 50, DAX, Bund etc.) are the deepest, while tail and some commodity/single-stock contracts are thinner, with higher impact cost under stress. The institutional anchor of liquidity provision is the Regulated Market Maker regime in Chapter IX of the Eurex Exchange Rules (Börsenordnung): exchange traders acting for a Regulated Market Maker must continuously enter binding quotes in at least one derivative and during 50% of the daily Trading Hours on a monthly average, meeting maximum spread and quoting-volume requirements set by the Management Board (verbatim in quote, Börsenordnung § 49); the pricing/stratification reading is an analytical characterisation

liquidity_risk_note.detail: 原字段曾靠 risks._meta.sources 继承蒙混（[ADR-074] 复核者点名的静默继承漏洞，[ADR-079] 不变式的首批命中项之一）：原 _meta 两条来源（Börsenordnung + licensing/supervision 页）均不直接支撑流动性分层判断，本次改以 Börsenordnung § 49 做市报价义务作为流动性供给的制度锚（字段级 sources），旗舰/长尾分层与冲击成本判断保持分析性定性。

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: 监管变更风险显著：作为欧盟 CCP，Eurex Clearing 持续受 EMIR 框架演进影响，最典型的是 EMIR 3.0（Regulation (EU) 2024/2987）对第三国 CCP 敞口与风险共担规则的修订；此外 MiFID II、欧洲市场基础设施规则与潜在欧盟金融业交易税均可能改变成本与参与结构。交易所端规则也经管理董事会/Eurex 规则定期修订。
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: Regulatory-change risk is significant: as an EU CCP, Eurex Clearing is continuously affected by the evolution of the EMIR framework, most notably EMIR 3.0 (Regulation (EU) 2024/2987) revising third-country CCP exposure and risk-sharing rules; MiFID II, European market-infrastructure rules and a potential EU FTT could also reshape costs and access. Exchange-side rules are also periodically amended by the Management Board / Eurex rulebook.

sources.title: Eurex Clearing — Licensing & supervision（官网，EMIR 授权）

regulatory_change_risk_note.quote: Eurex Clearing AG has been granted authorization as a Central Counterparty (CCP) under the European Market Infrastructure Regulation (EMIR) on 10 April 2014.

enforcement_note.zh: 市场操纵与执法由交易所交易监视办公室（Trading Surveillance Office）一线监控持仓与异常，并由 BaFin/ESMA 依欧盟《市场滥用规制》(MAR) 实施监管执法。交易所规则要求对持仓限额合规进行核查与报送。
enforcement_note.en: Market-manipulation oversight is first-line monitored by the Trading Surveillance Office for positions and anomalies, with regulatory enforcement by BaFin/ESMA under the EU Market Abuse Regulation (MAR). The rules require verification and reporting of compliance with position limits.

sources.title: Exchange Rules of Eurex Deutschland（官网英文版PDF）

enforcement_note.quote: The Trading Surveillance Office examines all positions of an Admitted Company, including Agent Position Accounts, to verify compliance with the position limits.
